integrity: One all-dimensional theorem supported by explicit graph descriptions, exact invariant-subspace decompositions, a polynomial identity certificate, and a separate small-dimensional cofactor; finite checks are only corroborative.
limitations: The comparison concerns the specified canonical pair, not exceptional additional minimizers. The remaining quotient spectrum is not resolved into a uniform radical expression. Equivalent literature under another graph name cannot be excluded absolutely.
title: Spectral and spanning-tree separation of sparse polytope f-vector twins
